Plugin.Name: Editable File Types
Plugin.Overview: Choose which file extensions Unraid's File Manager opens in its text editor, from a settings page instead of editing /boot/config/editor.cfg by hand. Tick common text formats (json, yaml, toml, md, env, log and more) or add your own, undo the last change, or restore the file exactly as it was before the plugin touched it. A backup is written before every save. It only reads and writes that one file, runs nothing in the background and makes no network connections.
